messages.subject: Payment plan — INV-AR-007
messages.body_text:
Hello Accounts Receivable,

This is Northwind Labs AP (CUST-001).

We acknowledge open invoice INV-AR-007 for $12,000.00 USD, due 2026-09-30.

We will pay the full $12,000.00 on INV-AR-007 by ACH on 2026-09-30 (on our due-date cycle). No dispute on this invoice.

Our other open items (INV-AR-001 $12,000.00 due 2026-10-15 and INV-AR-022 $6,400.00 due 2026-10-22) remain scheduled for their due dates; this note covers INV-AR-007 only.

Please reply if you need a remittance advice format or bank reference once the ACH posts.

Regards,
Northwind Labs — Accounts Payable

messages.subject: September 2026 operating account statement available
messages.body_text:
Treasury / Controllership,

This notice is from First National Operating regarding your commercial operating account.

Your monthly account statement for the period 01 September 2026 through 30 September 2026 is now available. This is a bank statement notice only. It is not an invoice, and no payment is requested.

Please retrieve the statement through online banking or your usual statement delivery channel and retain it with your September cash records.

If your internal books do not tie to the statement figures, route any difference through your normal bank-reconciliation process. Do not treat this message as a vendor bill or as confirmation that any individual bank line has been matched.

Questions on statement access: notices@firstnational.example

First National Operating
Account Services
notices@firstnational.example
